courses.title: Guitar Fundamentals
courses.description: Learn the basics of playing guitar with our comprehensive beginner's course.
syllabus: Introduction to Acoustic & Electric Guitar anatomy
Essential open chords and strumming patterns
Fingerpicking fundamentals and rhythm timing
Reading guitar tabs and lead chord progressions
Capstone: Playing your first complete acoustic song

courses.title: Piano for Beginners
courses.description: Start your musical journey with foundational piano skills taught by expert instructors.
syllabus: Keyboard posture, hand positioning, and note reading
Treble & bass clef mastery and rhythm basics
Major and minor scales, arpeggios, and triad chords
Two-hand coordination and smooth dynamic control
Performance piece: Classical & Contemporary miniatures

courses.title: Advanced Vocal Techniques
courses.description: Enhance your singing with advanced vocal techniques for intermediate to advanced learners.
syllabus: Diaphragmatic breath support & vocal tract acoustics
Expanding chest-to-head voice mix and eliminating vocal breaks
Vibrato control, pitch accuracy, and vocal ornamentation (runs & riffs)
Microphone technique and studio vocal projection
Final performance assessment & custom vocal range audit

courses.title: Drumming Mastery
courses.description: Master the drums with our comprehensive course covering all skill levels.
syllabus: Stick grip, ergonomics, and pedal stroke mechanics
Essential 40 drum rudiments applied across the kit
Groove construction in Rock, Funk, and Latin styles
Limb independence and polyrhythmic development
Studio recording techniques for acoustic & electronic kits

courses.title: Jazz Improvisation
courses.description: Learn the art of jazz improvisation with this course designed for all levels.
syllabus: Modal theory, ii-V-I progressions, and chord-scale relationships
Bebop scales, guide tones, and enclosure techniques
Developing melodic motifs and real-time storytelling
Comping rhythms and accompanying soloists
Transcribing master solos and stylistic analysis

courses.title: Music Production Fundamentals
courses.description: Dive into music production with this introductory course on the basics of sound engineering and mixing.
syllabus: DAW navigation, signal routing, and MIDI workflow
EQ, dynamic compression, reverb, and delay basics
Vocal tuning, drum replacement, and layer stacking
Rough mixing, gain staging, and frequency balancing
Mastering essentials for streaming platforms
highlights: Project Template Files for Ableton & Logic

courses.title: Songwriting Essentials
courses.description: Learn the essentials of songwriting to express your musical creativity.
syllabus: Song structures: Verse, Pre-Chorus, Hook & Bridge architecture
Lyric writing: Rhyme schemes, metaphors, and emotional arcs
Melodic hooks, prosody, and harmonic color choices
Arrangement dynamics and demo production
Publishing, copyright registration, and pitching to artists

courses.title: Electronic Music Production
courses.description: Create compelling electronic music with our course designed for beginners to advanced users.
syllabus: Synthesizer sound design: Subtractive, Wavetable, and FM
Creating custom basslines, plucks, leads, and atmospheric pads
Beat construction, sidechain compression, and build-up tension
Arranging EDM, House, Techno, and Ambient tracks
Master bus processing and club-ready loudness balancing

courses.title: Classical Music History
courses.description: Explore the rich history of classical music from its origins to the present day.
syllabus: Medieval chant through Renaissance polyphony
The Baroque masters: Bach, Handel, and Vivaldi
Classical form & symmetry: Mozart, Haydn, Beethoven
Romantic expressivism, Nationalism, and Orchestral expansion
20th Century Modernism, Minimalist movements & Film scoring

courses.title: Blues Guitar Techniques
courses.description: Discover the techniques of blues guitar to add soul and depth to your playing.
syllabus: 12-bar blues progressions, turnaround variations, and shuffle rhythms
Minor and major pentatonic blending & the elusive blue note
Bending nuance, vibrato styles (B.B. King vs. SRV), and string muting
Slide guitar fundamentals and open tunings (Open D & G)
Improvising expressive blues solos over live rhythm sections
